title: 第206章 从天而降第205章 大比开启
slug: 大婚之日我阉了未婚妻的白月光
lines: 一大早，神城中心广场，早已人山人海。
广场正北，搭建一座高台，中州五大古族，来了不少高层人物！
姜家代表，以姜大磐为首，姜远山、苏婉、姜扶摇一家三口坐在末席。
姬氏代表，姬中皇，姬沐辰。
轩辕氏代表，轩辕蒹葭、轩辕逸飞。
澹台氏代表，澹台圣尼、澹台飞旋。
他们高高在上，气度非凡地坐在席位上，俯瞰全场！
“五大商会的人到了！”
人群一阵骚动。
吴应熊、宋剑锋、汪梅、魏子卿、万崇山五人，带着各自商会的人马，昂首挺胸地走进专属区域，脸上带着毫不掩饰的傲慢！
紧接着，万宝楼的人也到了！
苏幕遮依一身紧致的旗袍，扭动着水蛇腰，风情万种地走来！
“听说赛洛璃离开万宝楼后，苏幕遮上位，如今已经是万宝楼的少楼主！”
“赛洛璃可惜了，好端端的和那叶凡混在一起！否则，少楼主之位绝对是她的！”
“嘿嘿……人家叶凡，对赛洛璃也不赖呢，直接一百亿从王家手里，买走赛洛璃！好大的手臂！”
“谁不知道，赛洛璃整个赌城的大部分男人都睡过她啊！哈哈哈哈……”一个男子大笑。
下一秒。
人群中传来一声怒喝：“放你妈的屁！”
说话的男子回头。
只见。
萧容妃、萧雅妃、赛洛璃、秦仁等人，打着天下第一拍卖行的旗号走来！
赛洛璃俏脸上满是怒容：“本姑娘在赌城睡过谁？嗯？”
“是睡了你爹，还是睡了你爷爷？要是真的睡过你爹，睡过你爷爷！”
“你是不是要要叫本姑娘一声奶奶？或者一声娘呢？嗯？”
“满嘴喷粪的东西，再胡说八道一句，本姑娘撕了你的臭嘴！”
性格泼辣！
气势丝毫不弱！
说话的男子脸色一下子白了，支支吾吾说不出话来！
萧容妃和萧雅妃二人，也目光冰冷的锁定这名男子！
这段时间的接触，两人早就知道，赛洛璃只是性格泼辣！有些时候，喜欢说一些让人脸红心跳的话，这几日，赛洛璃连她们二人都调戏过。
可二人知道，赛洛璃心底实际上非常温柔善良！
吴应熊终于忍不住，放声大笑起来：“哈哈哈哈！怎么就你们几个？”
“一个被血色商会抛弃的废人！一个人尽可夫的荡妇！”
“秦仁！赛洛璃！你们天下第一拍卖行还真是垃圾回收站呢！叶凡这个回收站的站长呢？怎么还不露面？”
“怎么？这是怕了？知道自己比不过，所以当缩头乌龟了吗？”
他声音极大，传遍整个广场！
宋剑锋也阴阳怪气地附和：“吴兄此言差矣，说不定人家是家底亏空，拿不出东西来比，正在砸锅卖铁呢！”
“我看也是！那个叫叶凡的呢？前些日子不是很嚣张吗？怎么今天不见人了？该不会是知道自己要输，躲起来不敢见人了吧？”
五人一唱一和，引得周围一片哄笑！
萧容妃和萧雅妃二人，俏脸铁青。
content_en:
Early in the morning, the central square of the city was already crowded with people.
Directly north of the square, a high platform was built, and many high-level figures from the five ancient tribes in Zhongzhou came!
Representatives of the Jiang family, headed by Jiang Dapan, and Jiang Yuanshan, Su Wan, and Jiang Fuyao sat at the bottom of the table.
Representatives of the Ji family are Ji Zhonghuang and Ji Muchen.
Representatives of the Xuanyuan family are Xuanyuan Jianjia and Xuanyuan Yifei.
Representatives of the Tantai clan are Tantai Shengni and Tantai Feixuan.
They were high up, sitting on their seats with extraordinary magnanimity, overlooking the entire audience!
"People from the five major chambers of commerce are here!"
There was a commotion in the crowd.
Wu Yingxiong, Song Jianfeng, Wang Mei, Wei Ziqing, and Wan Chongshan, with their respective chambers of commerce, walked into the exclusive area with their heads high and undisguised arrogance on their faces!
Immediately afterwards, the people from Wanbao Tower also arrived!
Su Muzheyi was wearing a tight cheongsam, twisting her water snake waist, walking in a charming manner!
"I heard that after Sai Luoli left Wanbao Tower, Su Muzhe took over and is now the young building owner of Wanbao Tower!"
"It's a pity that Sai Luoli managed to hang out with that Ye Fan! Otherwise, the position of the young building owner will definitely belong to her!"
"Hehe... Ye Fan is not bad at Silori. He bought Silori directly from the Wang family for 10 billion! What a big arm!"
"Who doesn't know that most of the men in the casino in Sailuoli have slept with her! Hahahaha..." A man laughed.
The next second.
An angry shout came from the crowd: "Fuck you!"
The man who spoke turned back.
I saw.
Concubine Xiao Rong, Concubine Xiao Ya, Sai Luoli, Qin Ren and others came under the banner of the world's number one auction house!
Sai Luoli's pretty face was full of anger: "Who did this girl sleep with in the casino? Huh?"
"Did I sleep with your father, or did I sleep with your grandpa? If I really slept with your dad, I slept with your grandpa!"
"Are you going to call me grandma? Or mother? Huh?"
"You are full of shit, if you talk nonsense again, I will tear your stinking mouth off!"
Fierce personality!
The momentum is not weak at all!
The man who spoke suddenly turned pale and was speechless!
Concubine Xiao Rong and Concubine Xiao Ya also locked eyes on this man with cold eyes!
During this period of contact, the two of them had long known that Sai Luoli just had a fierce personality! Sometimes, he likes to say things that make people blush and make their hearts beat. In the past few days, Sai Luoli has even teased the two of them.
But the two of them knew that Sailuoli was actually very gentle and kind at heart!
Wu Yingxiong finally couldn't help it and laughed loudly: "Hahahaha! Why are there only a few of you?"
"A useless person who was abandoned by the Blood Chamber of Commerce! A slut who can do anything she wants!"
"Qin Ren! Sai Luoli! Your world's number one auction house is really a garbage recycling station! Where is Ye Fan, the director of the recycling station? Why haven't you shown up yet?"
"What? Are you afraid? You know you can't compete, so you're acting like a coward?"
His voice was so loud that it spread throughout the square!
Song Jianfeng also echoed in a weird way: "Brother Wu, what you said is wrong. Maybe he is short-term and has nothing to compare with, so he is trying to sell iron!"
"I think so! Where's the one named Ye Fan? Wasn't he very arrogant the past few days? Why didn't you see anyone today? Could it be that you knew you were going to lose, so you hid and didn't dare to see anyone?"
The five of them sang in harmony, causing everyone to burst into laughter!
Concubine Xiao Rong and Concubine Xiao Ya had pretty faces ashen.
